  // sand and grass
  const sandY=WORLD.shore-cam.y; ctx.fillStyle='#f6e0a3'; ctx.fillRect(0,sandY,W,44); ctx.fillStyle='#8ed96c'; ctx.fillRect(0,WORLD.grass-cam.y,W,H); ctx.fillStyle='#5aa54b'; ctx.fillRect(0,WORLD.grass-cam.y,W,16); // top edge
  for(let i=0;i<12;i++){ const fx=((i*150)-cam.x*0.8)% (W+200); const x0=fx< -80?fx+W+200:fx; const y0=WORLD.grass-cam.y+8; ctx.strokeStyle='#f6fff2'; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0,y0+20); ctx.lineTo(x0+6,y0+8); ctx.lineTo(x0+12,y0+20); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle='#fff6c5'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x0+6,y0+6,5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); }
 }
 function drawCloud(x,y,s){ ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y); ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.92)'; for(const p of [[-s*.25,4,s*.24],[0,-s*.08,s*.3],[s*.26,2,s*.22],[s*.45,10,s*.15]]){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p[0],p[1],p[2],0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); } ctx.fillRect(-s*.46,0,s*.95,s*.22); ctx.restore(); }
 function drawHazardBounds(){} // Damage zones remain active without red overlays or boundary lines.
 function drawGroundEnemy(g){ const q=screen(g),custom=groundArt[g.kind];if(custom){const source=player&&player.stage===6?edibleGroundArt[g.kind]||custom:custom,sw=source.naturalWidth||source.width,sh=source.naturalHeight||source.height,walkFps=g.kind==='raccoon'||g.kind==='rat'?3.2:5,frame=(Math.floor(time*walkFps+g.phase)%4+4)%4,frameW=sw/4,ratio=frameW/sh;ctx.save();ctx.translate(q.x,q.y);if(g.vx<0)ctx.scale(-1,1);ctx.drawImage(source,frame*frameW,0,frameW,sh,-g.size*ratio/2,-g.size/2,g.size*ratio,g.size);ctx.restore();return;}const cycle=(Math.floor(time*7+g.phase)%FLAP_CYCLE.length+FLAP_CYCLE.length)%FLAP_CYCLE.length,frame=FLAP_CYCLE[cycle],source=player&&player.stage===6?edibleGroundAtlas:hazardAtlas;if(g.kind==='alligator')drawAtlasSprite(source,HAZARD_SPR.alligator,frame,q.x,q.y,g.size,g.size*.68,g.vx<0);else drawAtlasSprite(source,HAZARD_SPR.gorilla,frame,q.x,q.y,g.size*.9,g.size,g.vx<0); }
 function drawBoat(b){ const q=screen(b),bob=Math.sin(time*2+b.phase)*5; if(hudsonLevel()&&ferryReady){ctx.save();ctx.translate(q.x,q.y+bob);if(b.vx<0)ctx.scale(-1,1);ctx.drawImage(ferryAtlas,-90,-48,180,96);ctx.restore();return;}if(b.kind==='sailboat'){ctx.save();ctx.translate(q.x,q.y+bob);if(b.vx>0)ctx.scale(-1,1);ctx.drawImage(twemojiImages.sailboat,-70,-91,140,182);ctx.restore();}else drawSprite(b.kind,0,q.x,q.y+bob,124,82,b.vx>0); }
 function drawEnemy(e){ const q=screen(e),cycle=(Math.floor(time*10+e.phase*10)%FLAP_CYCLE.length+FLAP_CYCLE.length)%FLAP_CYCLE.length; drawAtlasSprite(edible(e)?edibleFlightAtlas:enemyFlightAtlas,SPR[e.sprite],FLAP_CYCLE[cycle],q.x,q.y,e.size,e.size,e.vx<0); }
 function drawPlayer(){ if(!player) return; const q=screen(player); const stage=STAGES[player.stage]; const cycle=(Math.floor(player.frame)%FLAP_CYCLE.length+FLAP_CYCLE.length)%FLAP_CYCLE.length; drawSprite(stage.sprite,FLAP_CYCLE[cycle],q.x,q.y,stage.size,stage.size,player.vx<0); }
 function particleBurst(x,y,col,n){ for(let i=0;i<n;i++) particles.push({x,y,vx:rand(-120,120),vy:rand(-130,20),life:rand(.35,.8),col}); }
 function hit(amount,src){ if(player.inv>0) return; player.hp-=amount; player.inv=.55; if(src){ const dx=player.x-src.x,dy=player.y-src.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1; player.vx+=dx/d*90; player.vy+=dy/d*90; } particleBurst(player.x,player.y,'#ff6363',12); if(player.hp<=0){ playing=false; paused=false; pauseBtn.hidden=true; pauseShade.hidden=true; overlay.hidden=false; hud.hidden=true; playBtn.textContent='PLAY AGAIN'; if(score>best){ best=score; localStorage.setItem('gullRunEvoBest2',best); bestEl.textContent=best; } } }
 function checkEvolution(){ while(player.stage<STAGES.length-1 && player.xp>=STAGES[player.stage+1].need){ player.stage++; player.hp=Math.min(100,player.hp+20); particleBurst(player.x,player.y,'#ffe06e',24); } }
 function edible(e){ return player.stage>=Math.min(6, ['crow','bat','vampire','mosquito','wasp'].indexOf(e.kind)+1); }
 function visibleAirTarget(target){ const q=screen(target),halfW=target.size*.5,halfH=target.kind==='plane'?target.size*.33:halfW; return q.x+halfW>=0&&q.x-halfW<=W&&q.y+halfH>=0&&q.y-halfH<=H; }
 function resetAirTarget(target){ if(target.kind==='plane')planes=planes.filter(p=>p!==target);else ufos=ufos.filter(u=>u!==target); }
 function update(dt){ if(!playing||!player||paused) return; time+=dt; const stage=STAGES[player.stage];
   let dx=(keys.d||keys.arrowright?1:0)-(keys.a||keys.arrowleft?1:0)+joystick.x; let dy=(keys.s||keys.arrowdown?1:0)-(keys.w||keys.arrowup?1:0)+joystick.y; if(mouse.on){ const worldX=cam.x+mouse.x, worldY=cam.y+mouse.y; dx+=(worldX-player.x)/200; dy+=(worldY-player.y)/200; } const activeInput=Math.abs(dx)>.05||Math.abs(dy)>.05||mouse.on; const mag=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1; if(mag>1){dx/=mag;dy/=mag;} const accel=2200; player.vx+=dx*accel*dt; player.vy+=dy*accel*dt; if(!activeInput) player.vy+=GRAVITY*dt; const drag=Math.pow(.93,dt*60); player.vx*=drag; player.vy*=drag; const sp=Math.hypot(player.vx,player.vy); if(sp>stage.speed){ player.vx=player.vx/sp*stage.speed; player.vy=player.vy/sp*stage.speed; } player.x=clamp(player.x+player.vx*dt,50,WORLD.w-50); player.y=clamp(player.y+player.vy*dt,12,WORLD.h-12); player.frame+=dt*10; player.inv=Math.max(0,player.inv-dt); player.edge=Math.max(0,player.edge-dt); player.laser=Math.max(0,player.laser-dt);
   if((player.y<=TOP_DAMAGE_Y||player.y>=BOTTOM_DAMAGE_Y)&&player.edge<=0){ player.edge=.6; hit(8,{x:player.x,y:player.y<TOP_DAMAGE_Y?0:WORLD.h}); }
   for(const f of foods){ if(dist(player,f)<f.r+STAGES[player.stage].size*.3){ player.xp+=f.xp; score+=f.score; scoreEl.textContent=score; Object.assign(f,makeFood()); checkEvolution(); } }
   for(const h of healthDrops){ if(dist(player,h)<h.r+STAGES[player.stage].size*.3){ const hx=h.x,hy=h.y; player.hp=Math.min(100,player.hp+h.heal); score+=h.score; scoreEl.textContent=score; particleBurst(hx,hy,h.type==='diamond'?'#79e8ff':'#ffe66d',16); Object.assign(h,makeHealthPickup()); } }
   for(const e of enemies){ e.x+=e.vx*dt; e.y+=e.vy*dt+Math.sin(time*3+e.phase)*22*dt; if(e.x<80||e.x>WORLD.w-80)e.vx*=-1; if(e.y<SPACE_DEST_H+10||e.y>WORLD.ocean+90)e.vy*=-1; const collision=dist(player,e)<(STAGES[player.stage].size+e.size)*.36; if(collision){ if(edible(e)){ const ex=e.x,ey=e.y; score+=30; scoreEl.textContent=score; player.xp+=1; e.defeated=true; checkEvolution(); particleBurst(ex,ey,'#8fff7b',12); } else hit(9,e); } }enemies=enemies.filter(e=>!e.defeated);
   for(const g of grounds){ const lo=Math.max(80,g.origin-g.roam),hi=Math.min(WORLD.w-80,g.origin+g.roam); g.x+=g.vx*dt; if(g.x<lo){g.x=lo;g.vx=Math.abs(g.vx);} else if(g.x>hi){g.x=hi;g.vx=-Math.abs(g.vx);} if(dist(player,g)<(STAGES[player.stage].size+g.size)*.33){if(player.stage===6){g.defeated=true;score+=50;scoreEl.textContent=score;particleBurst(g.x,g.y,'#8fff7b',18);}else hit(14,g);} }grounds=grounds.filter(g=>!g.defeated);
   for(const b of boats){ b.x+=b.vx*dt; if(b.x<100){b.x=100;b.vx=Math.abs(b.vx);} else if(b.x>WORLD.w-100){b.x=WORLD.w-100;b.vx=-Math.abs(b.vx);} const by=b.y+Math.sin(time*2+b.phase)*5; if(Math.abs(player.x-b.x)<60&&Math.abs(player.y-by)<50) hit(12,{x:b.x,y:by}); }
   for(const p of planes){ p.x+=p.vx*dt; if(p.x<140){p.x=140;p.vx=Math.abs(p.vx);} else if(p.x>WORLD.w-140){p.x=WORLD.w-140;p.vx=-Math.abs(p.vx);} const py=p.y+Math.sin(time*2+p.phase)*8; if(Math.abs(player.x-p.x)<(stage.size+p.size)*.34&&Math.abs(player.y-py)<(stage.size+p.size)*.24) hit(18,{x:p.x,y:py}); }
   for(const u of ufos){ u.x+=u.vx*dt; if(u.x<120){u.x=120;u.vx=Math.abs(u.vx);} else if(u.x>WORLD.w-120){u.x=WORLD.w-120;u.vx=-Math.abs(u.vx);} if(dist(player,u)<(STAGES[player.stage].size+u.size)*.35) hit(16,u); }
   if(STAGES[player.stage].sprite==='mech'&&player.laser<=0){ let target=null,bestD=440; for(const airTarget of [...ufos,...planes]){ if(!visibleAirTarget(airTarget)) continue; const d=dist(player,airTarget); if(d<bestD){bestD=d;target=airTarget;} } if(target){ const dir=player.vx<0?-1:1,eyeX=player.x+dir*stage.size*.25,eyeY=player.y-stage.size*.13; lasers.push({x1:eyeX,y1:eyeY-4,x2:target.x,y2:target.y-3,life:.18},{x1:eyeX,y1:eyeY+4,x2:target.x,y2:target.y+3,life:.18}); target.hp-=1; player.laser=.3; if(target.hp<=0){ const tx=target.x,ty=target.y; score+=target.kind==='plane'?75:60; scoreEl.textContent=score; resetAirTarget(target); particleBurst(tx,ty,target.kind==='plane'?'#ffdf72':'#7bff8b',18); } } }
   for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){ const p=particles[i]; p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt; p.life-=dt; if(p.life<=0) particles.splice(i,1); } for(let i=lasers.length-1;i>=0;i--){ lasers[i].life-=dt; if(lasers[i].life<=0) lasers.splice(i,1); }
   if(playing&&player.stage===6&&enemiesLeft()===0){if(!nextLevelReady()){document.querySelector('.tip').textContent='Next stage artwork is loading…';}else advanceLevel();}
   cam.x=clamp(player.x-W/2,0,Math.max(0,WORLD.w-W)); cam.y=clamp(player.y-H/2,0,Math.max(0,WORLD.h-H)); updateHud();
 }
 function draw(){ ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H); drawBackground(); drawHazardBounds();
   // draw boats in water first
   for(const b of boats) drawBoat(b);
   // foods, detailed hazards, flying enemies, walkers, player, fx
   for(const f of foods){ const q=screen(f); if(q.x>-50&&q.x<W+50&&q.y>-50&&q.y<H+50) drawFood(f); }
   for(const h of healthDrops){ const q=screen(h); if(q.x>-60&&q.x<W+60&&q.y>-60&&q.y<H+60) drawHealthPickup(h); }
   for(const u of ufos){ const q=screen(u); if(q.x>-80&&q.x<W+80&&q.y>-80&&q.y<H+80) drawUfo(u); }
   for(const p of planes){ const q=screen(p); if(q.x>-140&&q.x<W+140&&q.y>-100&&q.y<H+100) drawPlane(p); }
   for(const e of enemies){ const q=screen(e); if(q.x>-120&&q.x<W+120&&q.y>-120&&q.y<H+120) drawEnemy(e); }
   for(const g of [...grounds].sort((a,b)=>(a.y+a.size*(a.kind==='alligator'?.34:.5))-(b.y+b.size*(b.kind==='alligator'?.34:.5)))){ const q=screen(g); if(q.x>-150&&q.x<W+150&&q.y>-150&&q.y<H+150) drawGroundEnemy(g); }
   for(const l of lasers){ const a=screen({x:l.x1,y:l.y1}), b=screen({x:l.x2,y:l.y2}); ctx.save(); ctx.strokeStyle='#42ff55'; ctx.lineWidth=8; ctx.shadowColor='#abff8a'; ctx.shadowBlur=16; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y); ctx.lineTo(b.x,b.y); ctx.stroke(); ctx.strokeStyle='#efffe8'; ctx.lineWidth=2.5; ctx.shadowBlur=0; ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore(); }
   for(const p of particles){ const q=screen(p); ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life/.8); ctx.fillStyle=p.col; ctx.fillRect(q.x,q.y,4,4); } ctx.globalAlpha=1;
   drawPlayer();
 }
 function loop(ts){ const dt=Math.min(.024,(ts-last)/1000||0); last=ts; update(dt); draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); } requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script></body></html>
